note: The source registry (specs/pulse). Adding or removing a source is an ordinary data change, not an OpenSpec change. Every entry records what the source yields, which field is its row id (the join key entries declare in their `feeds` map), its cadences, its robots/terms check, and the date it was last verified live.

status_rule.note: OpenRouter serves no status field of its own. Status is derived deterministically from `expiration_date`: absent -> active; in the past -> retired; within 365 days -> deprecated; further out -> active. The far-future sentinel dates the API carries (2098-12-31 on several z-ai rows, observed 2026-08-28) therefore read as active, which is what they mean — deriving `deprecated` from a sentinel would fire a false lifecycle timeline event on the joined entry.

mints.note: The launch set's one minting source (design D7). Every row whose id no entry declares mints a stub `content/wiki/model/<slug>.md` with all aliases classed `manual` (specs/pulse). One minting source deliberately, so cross-source duplicate stubs cannot arise at launch.

robots.detail: HTTP 200. `User-Agent: *` / `Allow: /` / `Disallow: /seo/`. The models endpoint is not under any disallowed prefix. It is a public, unauthenticated JSON API and is fetched once per day.

verification.detail: Fetched unauthenticated. Top-level keys: data, total_count, links. total_count 388, links.next null (no pagination). `id` is unique across all 388 rows. `created` spans 2023-05-28 to 2026-08-28. No row has a null `context_length`. 8 rows carry a non-null `expiration_date`.

seeds.note: This source's rows are dated, sourced historical events, which is what makes the launch-feed seeding in specs/pulse possible: on first ingestion its history seeds `data/changes.jsonl` marked `seeded: true` with the original dates and sources, so the home changed feed is populated on day one rather than starting empty.

robots.detail: HTTP 200 (redirects to www). Disallows /admin, /api/admin, /api/cron, /api/candidates, /api/indexnow, /api/v1 and /data/. `/feed.xml` is not disallowed, and the site's own <head> advertises it as `<link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml">`. The disallowed /api/v1 and /data/ paths are never fetched.

verification.detail: The URL named in design D7, https://llm-releases.com, returns HTTP 200 but is a 1.3 MB client-rendered Next.js HTML page. The Pulse instead fetches the machine-readable representation the site itself advertises in that page's <head>, https://llm-releases.com/feed.xml — same source, robots-allowed, declared by the publisher for this purpose, and stable to parse. 60 items, all 60 carrying a <source url=...> vendor link (the archived source reference). `guid` is unique across all 60; `link` is NOT unique (54 distinct links; 5 model pages carry 2-3 events each), which is why `guid` and not `link` is the row id. pubDate spans 2026-06-29 to 2026-08-24; channel lastBuildDate Mon, 24 Aug 2026. No item in the current 60-item window is a retirement or deprecation — the window is releases and updates only, so launch seeding yields release history and no retirement history.
